title: Refuelling Charges Added to a Challenged Amount on Car Hire
content:
Where the ledger of a rental booked under the Car Rental Rate Classes carries a refuelling service charge,
that charge may be added to the amount the renter puts in dispute. What decides how much of it is added is whether a fuel dispute already
stands declined against that rental.

1. Where the ledger carries a refuelling service charge on the rental and no fuel dispute stands declined
   against the rental, the whole of that charge is added.
2. Where the ledger carries a refuelling service charge on the rental and a fuel dispute stands declined
   against it, 25 per cent of that charge is added.
3. Where the ledger carries no refuelling service charge on the rental, nothing is added for fuel.

## How the two cases divide

The two cases divide on a single mark, and between them they cover every rental whose ledger carries a
refuelling service charge: with no such dispute declined the whole charge is added, and with one or more
declined a quarter of it is added.

A fuel dispute standing declined is one already decided against the renter on that rental. A fuel dispute
still open against the rental is not one standing declined, and the first case answers.

## A refuelling charge worked through

A rental on a class whose refuelling service charge is 32 USD, with no fuel dispute standing declined
against it: 32 USD is added. The same rental with a fuel dispute standing declined: 25 per cent of 32 USD,
which is 8 USD, is added.
